newsitem.title: UK: Airtours up as analysts raise forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Airtours up as analysts raise forecasts.

text.p: Shares in leisure group Airtours Plc extended early gains on Wednesday despite the overall market weakness, as analysts raised their full-year forecasts after the group reported a sharp rise in yearly profits.
The stock was up 9-1/2 pence at 712-1/2p by 1535 GMT.
Nigel Hicks, analyst at BZW, said he had raised his pre-tax profit forecast for next year to 105 million stg from a previous 100 million.
And ABN AMRO Hoare Govett analyst Andrew Hunter said he had revised up his forecast to 103 million sterling from a previous 100 million.

Earlier, Airtours posted a better-than-expected 46 percent rise in profits to 86.8 million stg for the year to the end of September. The group added that summer bookings were running well ahead of last year.

Yet analysts were cautious on the outlook for the stock, which has risen strongly in recent months. It reached a near-record 715p earlier today, and has almost doubled in value since the beginning of the year.
